documentation.summary: Robinhood describes external-agent long equity, options and crypto ordering. Options multi-leg orders are excluded; crypto pairs/accounts and applicable permissions are limited. This page is context, not this host capability evidence.
The source describes equities generally. Individual ETF eligibility and the requested ETF host scope have not been observed; no blanket ETF support or denial is inferred.

This external-agent trading page does not establish futures, FX or bond order support. Other Robinhood products or website navigation do not establish the external-agent tool capability. This is not a permanent unsupported designation.
